sources: User-supplied logo artwork (Atlassian, Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Loom, Community lockups)
note: mark.svg / mark-white.svg / favicon.svg use the official two-peak Atlassian 'A' geometry with the classic #0052CC to #2684FF gradient, matching the supplied lockup artwork. Product marks (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Loom) are inlined in src/components/brand/AppMark.tsx with the same official geometry. community.svg is a stylised four-colour pinwheel hexagon approximating the Atlassian Community mark. Official Charlie Sans is not licensed for this demo; Plus Jakarta Sans stands in for wordmarks.
